user.title: In Flames fireplace
user.description: Control a Tuya electric fireplace over your LAN, without the Tuya cloud. To fetch the device's local key, sign in once with the Smart Life (or Tuya Smart) app; after setup nothing talks to the cloud.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in with the Smart Life app (finds the local key for you)
menu_options.manual: Enter IP, device ID and local key manually

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure In Flames
reconfigure.description: Use this after re-pairing the fireplace in the app (that changes its local key) or if its IP changed.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in with the Smart Life app (finds the local key for you)
menu_options.manual: Enter IP, device ID and local key manually

cloud.title: Smart Life sign-in
cloud.description:
Enter your Smart Life user code. Find it in: {where}.

{error}

scan.title: Scan with the Smart Life app
scan.description:
In the Smart Life app tap **+** (top right) → **Scan**, scan this code and confirm the login in the app. Then press **Submit**.

{error}

pick.title: Choose your fireplace
pick.description: Electric fireplaces on this Smart Life account. Models marked untested may use different datapoints.

locate.title: Fireplace address
locate.description: {name} didn't answer the LAN discovery broadcast (Home Assistant and the fireplace may be on different networks/VLANs). Enter its IP address - a DHCP reservation for it is a good idea.

error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the session handshake or read status. Check the IP and local key.
error.invalid_key: The local key must be 16 characters.
error.scan_failed: Login not confirmed yet: {error}. A fresh QR code is shown - scan it and confirm in the app.

abort.already_configured: This fireplace is already configured (its settings were updated).
abort.wrong_device: That is a different device than this entry was set up for.
abort.no_fireplaces: No electric fireplace (Tuya category dbl) with a local key was found among the {count} devices on this account.
abort.unsupported_version: This device speaks Tuya protocol {version}; this integration supports 3.4 only.
